Definition: to hurl; specifically, to shoot; figuratively, to delude or betray (as if causing to fall)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cast, shoot, hurl; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to throw; 1a2) bow-shooters, bowmen (participle); 1b) (Piel) to throw down; 2) to beguile, deceive, mislead, deal treacherously; 2a) (Piel); 2a1) to beguile, deceive, mislead, trick; 2a2) to deal treacherously with, betray
